rows.Name: Experience Scroll
rows.Description: A booster that increases experience gain by 100%. The effect lasts 30 min.

rows.Name: Summoning Scroll
rows.Description: Summons 5 random monsters, including 4 common and 1 common or rare.

rows.Name: Ingredients Scroll
rows.Description: A booster that increases the number of alchemy ingredients acquired from monsters and plants by 100%. The effect lasts for 30 min.

rows.Name: Range Scroll
rows.Description: Increases the range of interaction on the map by 50%. The effect lasts for 30 min.
